analysis.r2_residual_analysis: R1 residual was tested for any remaining structure and is statistically exhausted on all 5 pairs: (1) controlled 5-seed screen reproduces target marginal stats on 5/5 (mean diff <=0.04 lv, pct0 <=0.07 pp, p99.9 diff <=1.0 lv, dvr_rel <=0.014, dchroma_rel <=0.018); (2) Var(target-mean_sim)/Var(seed field)=1.19-1.22 = theoretical 1+1/5 for an exact pipeline, i.e. zero excess deterministic variance; (3) residual FWHM of target-vs-sim equals the sim-vs-sim seed control on 5/5 (8/8, 8/8, 8/8, 4/4, 8/8 px), so the sole verify_signals mismatch is a seed artifact; (4) SB6 signature of target-vs-sim equals seed control (extreme_pct 55.9/55.9, 66.6/66.6, 63.0/62.9, 66.8/66.6, 65.1/65.2; spatial_corr 0.9504/0.9504 ... 0.9425/0.9417; rgb_ratio 2.73/2.73 ... 1.44/1.43; ccc 0.473/0.474 ... 0.204/0.203; residual_std 30.9/30.8 ... 20.5/20.4); vm_slope/var_slope flip sign in both residuals -> unreliable, not evidence; (5) no low-frequency bias vs clean brightness (|<0.5| lv per 25-level bin), edge magnitude (<=0.45 lv) or chroma magnitude (<=0.5 lv on a ~180 scale); (6) per-brightness and per-chroma-bin residual-variance ratio target:control is flat 2.0-2.2, excluding Poisson (var~mean) and speckle (var~mean^2) noise families; (7) channel-shape fingerprint identifies gaussian_RGB, not YCrCb (see alternative).
analysis.rationale: R2 was asked to find residual signal left unexplained by R1. None survives statistical scrutiny: every deterministic-style statistic (marginal distributions and their seed variance, residual variance, FWHM, SB6 fingerprint, brightness/edge/chroma-conditioned bias and variance) of target-minus-R1-simulation is indistinguishable from two independent realizations of the R1 pipeline. The remaining uncertainty (noise type within the RGB family is still formally unidentifiable per SKILL noise-first 54.7%, hence UNCERTAIN and never LIKELY) is intrinsic, not addressable by another pipeline choice. The only new positive finding raises confidence in the declared pipeline: the per-channel residual-variance fingerprint uniquely selects RGB gaussian over YCrCb. Therefore R2 keeps the R1 pipeline unchanged.
